// colors: Each colour has a value and a role. Roles drive contrast checks: say 'background', 'text', 'accent', 'panel', or 'never text' for decorative colours. Slides reference them as var(--brand-<name>) (camelCase names become kebab-case: accentOnInk -> --brand-accent-on-ink).
// fonts: Filled by scripts/fonts.mjs (Google Fonts) or by hand for the user's own files. Each role -> { family, files: [{ path, weight, style }] }. Slides use var(--brand-font-heading) etc.
// typeScale: px sizes per hierarchy level. 'hook' is the slide-1 headline. Slides use var(--brand-size-<level>). Nothing below 28 except meta.
// spacing: px. margin = the outer margin slides actually use; safeArea = the hard limit the render script enforces.
// logo: Paths relative to this folder. primary = for light backgrounds, alt = for dark. Slides use {{LOGO}} / {{LOGO_ALT}} on an .
// retention: Text budgets enforced by the render script. Defaults come from references/retention-framework.md; only set keys here to TIGHTEN them. Loosening needs a deliberate reason.
